info.title: v2.public.get_access_token
info.description: Use the code from the authorization step to call this API to obtain the authorized shop_id, merchant_id, supplier_id, or user_id, and its corresponding access_token and refresh_token.

post.description: Use the code from the authorization step to call this API to obtain the authorized shop_id, merchant_id, supplier_id, or user_id, and its corresponding access_token and refresh_token.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: The code in redirect url after the authorization. Valid for one-time use, expires in 10 minutes

parameters.name: main_account_id
parameters.description: The main_account_id of the seller that authorized the developer.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

values:
<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/auth/token/get?partner_id=partner_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'POST',
  CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => '{
    "code": "5a5477794a55537954697169514f4653",
    "partner_id": 1001141
}',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;
